text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Syrian President Assad sends letter to Algerian President Zeroual about Arab situation, developments in peace process and Syrian position on peace talks with Israel. Syrian Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam says: "Israel is manoeuvring and there are no signs that it is retracting from its policies."
- International interest in peace process increases; Egypt's President Mubarak calls for resuming talks on Syrian-Israeli track according to Madrid (land-for-peace) formula.
- U.N. Secretary-General Annan calls for Israeli withdrawal from Arab lands.
- Morocco hails Syrian position in peace process.
- Syria exports cereals worth $179 million in 1996; difficulties in shipping and small ports and silos hinder efforts to increase exports.
- Vice-President Khaddam sends message to Iranian Vice-President Habibi.
